sheets.title: An account's toolbar and credentials — 390 wide
sheets.caption: Share is a key beside favorite, edit and delete. The API key shows its header with a copy key, the whole header line to reveal and copy, and a token its bearer line.
sheets.before: Three keys; Header had no copy key; no header line
sheets.after: Four keys, Share among them; every credential copies

sheets.title: Share once, opened from the toolbar — 390 wide
sheets.caption: The key is pressed and the ceremony opens under the fields. How long it lasts is three choices, not a dropdown.
sheets.before: A headed Share once group under the fields, with a duration dropdown
sheets.after: The pressed key, three duration choices, then Seal and share

sheets.title: A row's menu — 390 wide
sheets.caption: Copy asks which credential, and Copy username keeps its own row.

sheets.title: Copy, opened — 390 wide
sheets.caption: Every credential the account holds: the password, the API key and its header line, the token and its bearer line. On a phone the choices replace the list, with a way back.
sheets.before: Choosing Copy secret copied one value and closed the menu
